title: Dinosaur with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='sparkle' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffffff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#fff9c4'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M18 78 Q8 68 12 54 Q16 46 24 50 Q20 60 26 70 Z' fill='#2e9e5b'/>
  <!-- tail tip -->
  <path d='M12 54 Q8 48 14 44 Q20 42 22 48 Q18 50 16 56 Z' fill='#7ee8a2'/>
  <!-- back legs -->
  <rect x='34' y='72' width='12' height='18' rx='5' fill='#2e9e5b'/>
  <rect x='54' y='72' width='12' height='18' rx='5' fill='#237a46'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='90' rx='9' ry='5' fill='#7ee8a2'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='90' rx='9' ry='5' fill='#5ccf85'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='30' ry='24' fill='#39c46f'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='70' rx='18' ry='14' fill='#b8f5cd'/>
  <!-- back spikes -->
  <path d='M60 40 L66 30 L72 40 Z' fill='#f7c948'/>
  <path d='M72 46 L80 38 L84 50 Z' fill='#f7c948'/>
  <path d='M44 40 L38 30 L32 42 Z' fill='#f0b429'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <path d='M62 42 Q70 30 74 22 L86 24 Q82 36 76 48 Z' fill='#39c46f'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='80' cy='22' rx='16' ry='13' fill='#39c46f'/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='92' cy='25' rx='10' ry='8' fill='#7ee8a2'/>
  <!-- nostrils -->
  <circle cx='97' cy='23' r='1.6' fill='#1f5c37'/>
  <circle cx='92' cy='22' r='1.6' fill='#1f5c37'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M86 30 Q90 34 95 31' fill='none' stroke='#1f5c37' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='79' cy='17' r='6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='18' r='3.4' fill='#1a1a3a'/>
  <!-- sparkles in eye -->
  <path d='M78 14 L79 16 L81 15 L79.5 17 L82 18 L79.5 18.5 L80 21 L78 19 L76 21 L77 18.5 L74.5 18 L77 17 L76 14.5 Z' fill='url(#sparkle)'/>
  <circle cx='76.5' cy='20' r='1.3' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- little arm -->
  <path d='M70 58 Q78 56 82 62 Q78 64 72 64 Z' fill='#2e9e5b'/>
  <!-- extra sparkle floating -->
  <path d='M64 14 L65.5 17 L69 17.5 L66.3 19.6 L67 23 L64 21 L61 23 L61.7 19.6 L59 17.5 L62.5 17 Z' fill='#fff59d'/>
  <path d='M90 8 L91 10.5 L93.5 11 L91.3 12.7 L91.9 15.5 L90 13.7 L88 15.5 L88.6 12.7 L86.5 11 L89 10.5 Z' fill='#ffffff'/>
</svg>
